heroHeadline: Oman Joins Diplomatic Push as Iran and Muscat Hold UNGA Talks on Hormuz Navigation
heroSubtitle: Oman and Iran met on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly on Sep 26 to discuss Hormuz navigation, with Oman potentially taking on a mediation role — adding a new back-channel alongside the Qatari and Pakistani tracks Iran has been using to relay reopening conditions to Washington
